purpose: Document first-party Attingal/ Kerala cadastral-service discovery and bounded anonymous access attempts.
assessment: Official Kerala cadastral service descriptions and Attingal survey-custodian references are evidenced. No parcel polygon was retained because the primary public Bhu-Naksha host failed TLS verification and no other inspected official page returned anonymous parcel geometry. The packet is complete as a research record, with runtime held.
registryAssessment: Local/state cadastral custody is evidenced by Kerala Revenue/Survey sources: the official CMO directory lists the Superintendent Survey and Land Records (Resurvey) Attingal, Ente Bhoomi lists an Attingal digital-survey camp office, and Bhu-Naksha is the Kerala Land Records Modernization Mission cadastral map service. Attingal Municipality is separately evidenced as local government, but no municipal parcel-vector service was verified.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official Kerala Bhu-Naksha page exposes cadastral search concepts for block, survey, and subdivision numbers; direct TLS verification failed in this environment.
Official Revenue page describes e-maps as an end-to-end cadastral mapping system and says citizens can obtain an updated digital sketch of individual parcels.
Official Kerala directory lists Superintendent Survey and Land Records (Resurvey) Attingal.
Official Ente Bhoomi page lists Attingal under Chirayinkeezhu and gives an Attingal digital-survey camp-office location.
Official Attingal Municipality portal confirms local government and public property-tax/service context; it did not expose parcel geometry in the inspected page.
